summary: Purple Biotech Ltd. filed Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, attaching a press release announcing new preclinical data for IM1240 presented at EACR 2026. The release highlights IM1240's anti-tumor activity, safety, and pharmacokinetic profile from non-human primate toxicology studies and patient-derived tumor samples. This is a routine disclosure of scientific progress by a clinical-stage oncology company. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is described. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of ordinary business developments.
